description:
Normalized statement with data-quality overlay

Return a normalized EDGAR statement for a given identity tuple, combined with its fact-level data-quality overlay (fact-quality flags and anomalies). It answers as GET /v1/edgar/companies/{cik}/statements/dq/overlay does.

accession_id.description: SEC accession of the filing whose statement to overlay, as returned by /v1/edgar/companies/{cik}/statements. The filing's current statement is read; an accession that serves no statement for the identity answers 404 with details.available_accessions.

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193). Send this or `ticker`, not both.

fiscal_period.description: Fiscal period within the year (e.g., FY, Q1, Q2).

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year associated with the statement (>= 1). The filer's own name for its fiscal year, as its annual reports declare it: a year closing 2025-02-01 that the filer calls fiscal 2024 is served as 2024.

statement_date.description: End date of the statement's period (YYYY-MM-DD). Needed only when the filing reports more than one statement for the fiscal year and period: a fiscal year split at a business combination or fresh-start reorganization is reported as two OTHER periods. Without it such a request answers 409 `EDGAR_STATEMENT_AMBIGUOUS`, listing the dates in `details.available_statement_dates`.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol naming the company, in place of `cik`; send one or the other. Resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

name: fundamentals_normalized_statements_dq_overlay
